items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: That was right after Huey Long came in there and put all of these loan sharks out of business.

ctx.x: Hebert was, uh, some dinner for Eddie Hebert, which I had the music for. And Kefaubber came down here, was when, Kefaubber was the one that put all of these guys out of business. Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, they had a special, uh, before the dinner, they had the VIP room, cocktails before the dinner. And I went over there and Eddie, who had autographed my album. And, uh, Leon was just born. This was in 1952, 51. And, uh, I got Mr. Kefaubber to, uh, uh, to, uh, autograph my program, too. He was the principal speaker. So,…

Yeah, but you're talking about several years after. Yeah, this is after. This is long before that. Well, because when, uh, Huey Long was a guard, it shut, uh, shut Tommy Gets down. Yeah, he shut him down. So, uh, then we left there. We stayed there a few weeks after that. And, uh, we let, uh, then we let, uh, Johnny Laporte go because, I don't think Johnny played well enough. Bill didn't like him and Eddie Miller didn't like, care for him that much either. So then we went out. Our next job was the Hunnis, was,…
Wasn't Hip Henley in partnership with Leon and Chalky down at the Hollywood Inn?
